title: Redesigned MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs
body: The MLflow run page **Logs** tab for AI Runtime runs now supports searching and filtering logs by node, level, and time range, following a running workload as new output arrives, and downloading logs. For new runs, it replaces the log files previously stored on the run's **Artifacts** tab, which are deprecated. Logs are available for 60 days. Logs for existing runs remain on the **Artifacts** tab. See [View logs in the MLflow Logs tab](/aws/en/machine-learning/ai-runtime/monitor-deploy/tracking-observability#logs-tab).
